definite_issue.evidence: Slurm documents that with --export=ALL,NAME=value, an existing value in the sbatch caller environment takes precedence over the explicit value. Revision 1 did not set or verify the caller's PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE. An inherited empty or zero value therefore defeated the intended bytecode suppression; both make sys.dont_write_bytecode false in the frozen Python.
definite_issue.required_repair: Set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 atomically in the sbatch caller process as well as in --export. Also bind deterministic warning and locale values used by the exact log grammar.

scientific_effect: No remote task was created or submitted and no schema-v5 output existed under revision 1, so the flaw affected only the prelaunch guarantee and no scientific interpretation.
